description: Érosion côtière Lorient Agglomération is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by services.api.isogeo.com. Lorient Agglomération has been involved since 2002 in the development of a charter for the Environment and Sustainable Development. One of the actions includes the implementation of a coastal observatory, including the development of a coastal erosion monitoring programme. Establishment of an assessment of the knowledge that determines the evolution of the coastline. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Coastal erosion Lorient Agglomeration" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include lorient agglomération, environnement, risque, données ouvertes, sigec, littoral. The listing shows 2009-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
